description: This file contains the implementation of a configuration options validator for development cluster membership settings in Orleans, specifically validating the presence of primary silo endpoint when development clustering is enabled.

classes.name: DevelopmentClusterMembershipOptionsValidator
classes.description: A class that validates the development cluster membership options, ensuring proper configuration when development clustering is enabled.

methods.name: DevelopmentClusterMembershipOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the options and membership table based on dependency injection.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Method that checks if development clustering is enabled and if the primary silo endpoint is specified; throws exception if validation fails.
